text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ready up, Urara! I'm about to tell you
how to
make my special Shining Mud
Dumplings!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Golshi... I came here because you
promised with a
big, smug grin that you
had "extremely valuable
data" to share.
You'd better not tell me you were

referring to meaningless mud dumplings.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Par-don? What the flip else would I mean? I'm talkin' about how to create a national treasure here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Mud balls aren't a national treasure!
Tch... I'm
such an idiot to fall for your
nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! No fighting! Bad! Be nice and get
along
with each other!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not a fight... Hm? Wait, there's
something odd
about that pillar over
there. Is there... a hole in it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, the hole, yeah. I chucked a mud
dumpling
and—pop!—put a hole right
through it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?! Th-that's impossible! Just how
dense are
these dumplings of yours?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Golshi. Tell me how they're
formed. I'm
not leaving until you spit it
out!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah, now I've piqued your curiosity, eh? That's the end of that, then. It's too late for you. You've finally fallen down the endless rabbit hole that is... mud dumplings.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, now we're getting along great! ♪
